description: Free, confidential 24/7 navigator that connects South Carolinians to health and human services by phone, text, or web search.
24/7 suicide and crisis support by call, text, or chat. Connects people in the United States to trained counselors.

organization: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration
description: Confidential, 24/7 information service for people and families facing mental health or substance use conditions. Referral, not counseling.
Confidential support for people experiencing domestic violence, and for friends or family who are trying to help.
Free crisis support by text with a trained volunteer. Available 24/7 in the United States.
24/7 confidential support for veterans, service members, and their families. Call 988 and press 1, or use the chat and text options on the official site.
Confidential support for people affected by sexual violence. Connects callers to a local affiliated program when one is available.
24/7 crisis line for children, parents, and concerned adults facing child abuse or neglect. Professional counselors, not a Midnight Magnolia service.
Free civil legal assistance for eligible low-income South Carolinians. Does not handle criminal cases. Apply through statewide intake.

program: Legal information and SCLS online intake
description: Statewide legal information and the online intake path into South Carolina Legal Services. Not a substitute for a lawyer.
Food bank serving ten coastal South Carolina counties through partner pantries and distributions. Use the official food finder for the nearest site.

organization: SC Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities
description: State public mental health provider (formerly the Department of Mental Health). Community clinics and specialty programs across South Carolina.
Statewide affiliate network offering free mental health support groups, education, and advocacy. Local affiliates cover Charleston and other regions.
Protection and advocacy agency for the legal and civil rights of people with disabilities in South Carolina.

organization: South Carolina State Housing Finance and Development Authority
description: State housing finance agency. Information on rental assistance, homeownership programs, and housing resources as published on the official site.
County library system with branches, public computers, and community information. A belonging point, not a clinical service.
State vocational rehabilitation agency. Helps eligible people with disabilities prepare for, find, and keep work.

organization: South Carolina Department of Social Services
description: State agency for economic benefits, child welfare, and related family services. Use the official site for current application paths.
National searchable directory of local social services. A starting map, not a verification of every listed program.

description: Crisis intervention and suicide prevention for LGBTQ young people. Call, text, and chat options are listed on the official site.
